tips.title: STANDARD $79.99
tips.body: The full game. Boxed copies only hold a download code, no disc.

tips.title: ULTIMATE $99.99
tips.body: Adds the '95 Grotti Cheetah, Hawk + Little Morgan revolvers, the Ganado Retro Build, Jason's Safehouse Vehicles and more.

tips.title: FREE BONUS
tips.body: Vintage Vice City Pack: '55 Vapid Stanier + garage, outfits, hairstyles, a weapon pattern. Digital also gets 1 month of GTA+.

tips.title: UPGRADE ANYTIME
tips.body: Standard owners can buy the Ultimate Edition Upgrade later on PlayStation or Xbox stores.
